tools.name: sanctions_screen_entity
tools.description: Screen a single name or entity against the four major sanctions / denied-party lists (OFAC SDN, EU consolidated, UN consolidated, BIS DPL). Returns matches with confidence scores. This call uses the standard hosted query allowance; the free tier includes 1,000 queries/month and paid plans use the published plan pricing.

params.name: name
params.description: Name or entity string to screen.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum matches to return. Defaults vary per tool.

params.name: sources
params.description: Restrict screening to a subset of source lists. Defaults to all four. Allowed: OFAC_SDN, EU_CFSP, UN_SC, BIS_DPL.

params.name: threshold
params.description: Minimum confidence score (0..1) for a result to be returned. Defaults to 0.85.

tools.name: sanctions_screen_batch
tools.description: Screen up to 50 names in a single call. Returns one result block per input, in input order. Each name counts as one screen for billing purposes.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum matches to return. Defaults vary per tool.

params.name: names
params.description: Array of names to screen. Max 50.

params.name: sources
params.description: Restrict screening to a subset of source lists. Defaults to all four. Allowed: OFAC_SDN, EU_CFSP, UN_SC, BIS_DPL.

params.name: threshold
params.description: Minimum confidence score (0..1) for a result to be returned. Defaults to 0.85.

tools.name: sanctions_get_changes
tools.description: Return entities added or updated since a given ISO date for a chosen source list. The four official lists do not all expose a public delta feed, so this filters the cached snapshot by listedOn.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum matches to return. Defaults vary per tool.

params.name: since
params.description: ISO date string (e.g. 2026-01-01) to compute the delta from.

tools.name: sanctions_screen_address
tools.description: Match a physical address against listed addresses. Useful for KYC / supplier vetting when the counterparty's name is generic but the address is distinctive.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum matches to return. Defaults vary per tool.

params.name: sources
params.description: Restrict screening to a subset of source lists. Defaults to all four. Allowed: OFAC_SDN, EU_CFSP, UN_SC, BIS_DPL.

params.name: threshold
params.description: Minimum confidence score (0..1) for a result to be returned. Defaults to 0.85.

tools.name: sanctions_get_entity
tools.description: Fetch a full record by entity ID (e.g. "OFAC_SDN-44705"). The ID is self-describing and includes the source; obtain it from a screening result.

params.name: id
params.description: Entity ID from a screening result, e.g. "OFAC_SDN-44705".

tools.name: sanctions_search_alias
tools.description: Search aliases / AKAs across selected lists. Distinct from screen_entity in that only the alias fields are matched, which is helpful when the primary listed name differs sharply from the popular spelling.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum matches to return. Defaults vary per tool.

params.name: sources
params.description: Restrict screening to a subset of source lists. Defaults to all four. Allowed: OFAC_SDN, EU_CFSP, UN_SC, BIS_DPL.

params.name: threshold
params.description: Minimum confidence score (0..1) for a result to be returned. Defaults to 0.85.

tools.name: sanctions_status_summary
tools.description: Counts and last-update timestamps for all four lists in the cache. No screening is performed; this call is free.

tools.name: fred_releases
tools.description: Browse FRED economic releases (e.g. Employment Situation, CPI, GDP). With upcoming_dates=true, returns the upcoming release calendar instead. Useful for knowing when fresh data is expected.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum rows to return (default 50 for observations, 25 for catalog queries).

params.name: release_id
params.description: Optional. If provided, return only that release's metadata.

params.name: upcoming_dates
params.description: If true, return upcoming release date schedule instead of release metadata. Default false.

tools.name: edgar_company_lookup
tools.description: Look up a public company's CIK (Central Index Key) by ticker symbol or company name. CIK is required for all other EDGAR tools. Returns matches ranked exact-ticker first.

tools.name: edgar_recent_filings
tools.description: List recent SEC filings for a company. Filter by form type (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 4, DEF 14A, etc.) and start date. Use ticker or CIK as identifier.

tools.name: edgar_filing_content
tools.description: Fetch the text content of a specific SEC filing. Returns the primary document (10-K, 10-Q, etc.) stripped of HTML, suitable for LLM consumption. Use edgar_recent_filings first to get the accession number.

params.name: cik
params.description: Filer CIK (with or without leading zeros).

params.name: max_chars
params.description: Maximum characters of text to return (default 20000, max 200000).

tools.name: edgar_full_text_search
tools.description: Full-text search across all SEC filings via the EDGAR EFTS index. Filter by comma-separated form types and date range. Useful for finding filings that mention specific terms.

params.name: forms
params.description: Comma-separated form types to filter (e.g. '10-K,10-Q'). Optional.

tools.name: edgar_company_facts
tools.description: Get structured XBRL financial facts for a company. Without 'concept', returns the top-level facts catalog (concepts the company has reported). With 'concept' (e.g. 'Revenues', 'Assets', 'EarningsPerShareBasic'), returns the time series of values for that concept.

params.name: concept
params.description: Optional XBRL concept name (e.g. 'Revenues', 'Assets', 'NetIncomeLoss'). If omitted, returns the catalog of available concepts.
